# Native ABI and marshalling

[API index](index.md)

Summary of [`sdk/docs/native-signatures.md`](../native-signatures.md), which is the contract. Every wrapper describes its native with a signature string `"<args>><ret>"`; C, Python and Luau pack a call into 8-byte `g6_native_call` slots from that same string. The GTA VI slot layout differs from GTA V/RDR2 (`findings/phase5/23_handle_abi.md`). The type columns below are read from `gen_bindings.py`, so they match the generated code.

| Code | nativedb types | Slots | C | Python | Luau | Natives using it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `i` | int, Any, Player, Cam, Blip, ScrHandle, ... | 1 (sign-extended int32) | `int32_t` | `int` | `number` | 5087 |
| `e` | Entity, Ped, Vehicle, Object, Pickup, PersChar | 2 (16-byte opaque handle lo, hi) | `g6_entity` | `int` | `buffer \| number` | 1069 |
| `h` | ScenarioPoint (16-byte non-entity handle, from handler evidence) | 2 (16-byte opaque handle lo, hi) | `g6_handle16` | `int` | `buffer` | 16 |
| `u` | Hash, unsigned int | 1 (zero-extended uint32) | `uint32_t` | `int \| str` | `number \| string` | 430 |
| `f` | float | 1 (IEEE-754 bits in the low 32) | `float` | `float` | `number` | 739 |
| `b` | BOOL, bool | 1 (0/1) | `int` | `bool` | `boolean` | 453 |
| `s` | const char*, char* | 1 (pointer; caller keeps it alive) | `const char*` | `str \| None` | `string?` | 22 |
| `q` | uint64_t, argc_inferred filler slot | 1 (raw u64) | `uint64_t` | `int` | `number` | 279 |
| `w` | Vector3 parameter measured as packed (nativedb float x, y, z) | 2 (one 16-byte {x, y, z, w}: x, y in the first slot, z in the low half of the second) | `g6_vec3` | `Vector3` | `vector` | 204 |
| `v` | Vector3 parameter without handler evidence (legacy) | 3 (x, y, z floats) | `g6_vec3` | `Vector3` | `vector` | 0 |
| `S` | ScriptString: the handler reads a script String object (from handler evidence, G-120) | 1 (pointer to UTF-8 + its string_slots bit; the runtime passes a String built from it) | `const char*` | `str \| None` | `string?` | 31 |
| `T` | ScriptText: the handler reads a script text object (from handler evidence, G-120) | 1 (pointer to UTF-8 + its text_slots bit; the runtime passes a text object built from it) | `const char*` | `str \| None` | `string?` | 9 |
| `I` | int* out-param | 1 (pointer to scratch) | `int64_t*` | `int` appended to the returned tuple | `number` extra return value | 108 |
| `F` | float* out-param | 1 (pointer to scratch) | `float*` | `float` appended to the returned tuple | `number` extra return value | 18 |
| `B` | BOOL* out-param | 1 (pointer to scratch) | `int64_t*` | `bool` appended to the returned tuple | `boolean` extra return value | 4 |
| `V` | Vector3* (16-byte aligned Vec3V) out-param | 1 (pointer to scratch) | `g6_vec3_packed*` | `Vector3` appended to the returned tuple | `vector` extra return value | 19 |
| `E` | Entity*-family out-param | 1 (pointer to scratch) | `g6_entity*` | `int` appended to the returned tuple | `buffer` extra return value | 13 |
| `X` | Entity*-family in/out param (the handler reads the handle and writes it back; `script-vm.inout_params.json`) | 1 (pointer to scratch filled from the argument) | `g6_entity*` (caller fills it) | `int` argument, value read back appended to the returned tuple | `buffer \| number` argument, `buffer` extra return value | 8 |

Return codes follow `>`:

| Code | Meaning | C | Python | Luau | Natives returning it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `n` | void | `void` | `None` | `()` | 3473 |
| `i` | int32 | `int32_t` | `int` | `number` | 2307 |
| `u` | uint32 | `uint32_t` | `int` | `number` | 42 |
| `f` | float | `float` | `float` | `number` | 177 |
| `b` | BOOL | `int` | `bool` | `boolean` | 585 |
| `s` | string pointer | `const char*` | `str \| None` | `string?` | 1 |
| `q` | raw u64 | `uint64_t` | `int` | `number` | 0 |
| `e` | 16-byte entity handle in ret[0..1] | `g6_entity` | `int` | `buffer` | 62 |
| `h` | 16-byte scenario-point handle in ret[0..1] (all zero = none) | `g6_handle16` | `int` | `buffer` | 3 |
| `w` | packed 16-byte vector {x, y, z, w}: x, y in ret[0], z in the low half of ret[1] | `g6_vec3` | `Vector3` | `vector` | 192 |
| `v` | legacy 3-slot vector (compatibility only; GTA VI bindings use w) | `g6_vec3` | `Vector3` | `vector` | 0 |

Example: `GET_ENTITY_COORDS(Entity, BOOL, BOOL) -> Vector3` is `"ebb>w"` and uses 4 argument slots. `SET_ENTITY_COORDS` is `"ewbbbbf>n"`: entity in slots 0-1, the packed position in 2-3, four BOOLs in 4-7 and a float the handler loads from slot 8 (9 slots).

Key rules:

- **Entity handles** are 128-bit opaque keys. Pass a handle back exactly as a native returned it; a `lo` of 0 means no entity. `Player` stays a plain int (mixed slot width in the handler table).
- **Luau hashes** are passed to `native.resolve` as 16-digit hex strings, because Luau numbers are doubles. Entity handles travel as 16-byte `buffer`s for the same reason.
- **Untyped natives** get a generic u64 wrapper: raw slots in, the first return slot out (`G6_N_<hash>` / `N.RAW.N_<hash>`). Slots beyond the typed parameters are `q` and default to 0.
- **Status** is `verified`, `observed` or `unverified`. `observed` means the handler was located statically, not that its types are proven. Real backends refuse everything except `verified` (`G6_E_UNVERIFIED_NATIVE`) unless started with `allow_unverified`; the mock accepts everything.
- **Duplicate names**: when two hashes share a name, the lower-status (seed) hash keeps the base identifier and the other gets a hash-fragment suffix (`GET_ENTITY_COORDS_F44D`).
- **Vector3 parameters** are decided per native from the handler's argument loads (`re-db/builds/1.0.2.1/natives/script-vm.vector_params.json`): 204 natives take packed vectors (`w`), 1 reads three float slots, and 13 are **unconfirmed** (nativedb float slots kept; marked on their native pages). There is no global rule.
- **Vector3\* out-params** receive one 16-byte `vmovaps` store of `{x, y, z, w}`, so the buffer must be a 16-byte-aligned `g6_vec3_packed` (observed in GET_VEHICLE_NODE_POSITION, GET_MODEL_DIMENSIONS, GET_SHAPE_TEST_RESULT, _GET_VOLUME_BOUNDS, WAYPOINT_RECORDING_GET_COORD, GET_CLOSEST_FIRE_POS, GET_CLOSEST_ROAD). The GTA V 8-byte-stride `g6_vec3_slots` is not used.
- **Padding slots** beyond the nativedb parameters (`argc_inferred`) are `f` when the handler loads a 32-bit float from that slot and `q` otherwise; both are optional and default to 0.

6842 of 6842 natives have a typed signature.
